column2: In hostile rites likewise: stone, food, barley meal, milk, curds, alms, fruit and root — the Rigvedic rule is declared.
For villages, cities and countries too, Bhargava, those afflicted, knower of dharma, and the diseased,
when an epidemic has arrived and in fear born of enemies, the Rudra oblation is the supreme pacification, with pudding and ghee.
By an oblation of pumpkin and ghee he removes all sins. Living on barley meal and yavaka alms at night, best of men,
devoted to outer bathing, for months he is freed from Brahmin-killing. With the mantra "Madhu vata" by oblation and the rest one would obtain everything.
Having offered with "Dadhikravno" one surely obtains sons; likewise "Ghritavati" gives long life with ghee;
Svasti na Indra destroys all obstacles; "Iha gavah prajayadhvam" increases nourishment;
by a thousand ghee oblations likewise it destroys misfortune. Having offered with a ladle "Devasya tva" apamarga and rice,
one is quickly freed from hostile rites and deformity, no doubt. "Rudra pathu" — with palasha fuel one would obtain gold;
Shivo bhava — in a fire-portent a man should offer with rice; "Yah sena" removes fear of thieves.
Yo asmabhyam avatiyat — having offered black sesame, a man is freed a thousandfold from hostile and deformed (rites), twice-born.
With "Annenannapate" thus having offered one obtains food. "Hamsah shuchishat" recited in water destroys sin;
Chatvari in water takes away all sins; having recited "Deva yajna" one is honored in Brahma's world.
Having offered ghee with "Vasanta" one obtains a boon from the Sun; "Suparno asi" — its act is like the vyahritis.
Having repeated "Namah svaha" thrice one obtains release from bondage; having repeated "Drupada" thrice in water one is freed from all sin.
Iha gavah prajayadhvam — this mantra increases intelligence; offered with ghee, curds, milk or pudding.
Having offered leaves and fruits with "Shatam ya," one obtains health, prosperity and long life.
Oshadhih pratimodadhvam gives wealth in sowing and reaping; "Ashvavati" by pudding oblation obtains peace.
With the mantra "Tasmai" one in bondage is freed; with "Yuva suvasa" one obtains the best garments.
Munchantu ma shapathyani destroys all ends; "Ma mahimsih" offered with sesame and ghee destroys enemies.
Namo astu sarvasarpebhyah with ghee and pudding; "Krinudhvam raja" — this destroys hostile rites.
Having offered ten thousand durva stalks with "Kandat kandat," a man would quell an epidemic in village or country;
the disease-afflicted is freed from disease and the sorrowful from sorrow. Udumbara fuel, "Madhuman no vanaspatih,"
having offered a thousand times, Rama, a man obtains wealth; he obtains great good fortune and the triad in business.
Having offered "Apam garbham" one surely makes the god rain; likewise having offered curds, ghee and honey with "Apah piba,"
he brings on, knower of dharma, great rain thereafter. "Namaste rudra" destroys all calamities,
is declared the maker of all peace, destroyer of great sins; "Adhyavochat" is for the protection of the sick,
demon-slaying, fame-giving, increasing long life and nourishment; by throwing mustard seeds on the road and reciting it one is happy.
Asau yas tamra — reciting this daily, one should attend the sun, knower of dharma, evening and morning, untiring:
one obtains imperishable food and gains long life. "Pramunch dhanvan" — with six, the consecration of weapons,
frightening to enemies; no deliberation is to be made about it for battle. "Mano mahantah" is the peace-maker for children;
Namo hiranyabahave — the seven anuvakas; one should offer mustard smeared with pungent oil, destroying enemies.
Namo vah kirikebhyah — by oblations of a lakh of lotuses a man obtains royal fortune; likewise with bilva, gold.
Ima rudraya — by oblation of sesame wealth is gained; by durva oblation and others he becomes free of all disease.
Ashuh shishanah is declared for protection of weapons and in battle, Rama, destroying all enemies.
With "Rajasama" one should offer a thousand with five, twice-born; of ghee oblations, knower of dharma, one is freed from eye disease.
Shanno vanaspate — an oblation in the house removes house-site faults; having offered ghee with "Agna ayumsi" one meets hatred from none.
Having offered parched rice with "Apam phena" one obtains victory; reciting "Bhadra," one lacking senses would have all senses.
Agnish cha prithivi cha is the best subjugation; reciting "Adhvana" one becomes victorious in dealings.
Brahma rajanyam brings success at the start of work; "Samvatsarosi" with ghee, by a lakh oblations one becomes free of disease.
Ketum krinvan increases victory in battle; "Indro agnir dharma" gives dharma-binding in battle.
Dhanva naga is the mantra for taking the bow, the best; "Yajita" likewise is to be known for consecration.
Ahiratha is the mantra for consecrating arrows; "Vahninam pitar" is called the swift mantra;
Yunjanti is called the mantra for yoking horses; "Ashuh shishanah" where the beginning is told;
Vishnoh krama is the best mantra for mounting a chariot; "Ajangha" is declared for striking horses.
Yah sena abhitvari one should recite before the enemy's army; "Dundubhyah" is for beating the drum.
Having done thus with these mantras recited before, one becomes victorious. "Yamena dattam" — by a crore oblations the wise one
should quickly produce a chariot, giving victory in battle; "A krishnena" — its action is like the vyahritis.
By reciting "Shiva-sankalpa" one gains concentration of mind; by offering five lakhs with "Panchanadyah" one obtains prosperity.
Yada badhnan dakshayanah — a gold piece consecrated with this mantra a thousand times, worn, wards off enemies.
Imam jivebhyah — if one throws a stone and a clod in the four directions in the house, he has no fear of thieves at night.
Parime gam is the best subjugation; a man who has come to kill becomes subdued there;
one gives consecrated food, betel, flowers and the like — whoever receives, knower of dharma, comes under control quickly, gentle one.
Shanno mitrah always gives peace everywhere. Having made "Gananam tva ganapatim" the oblation at a crossroads,
one may subjugate the whole world with all grains, without doubt. "Hiranyavarnah shuchayah" is the mantra at consecration;
Shanno devir abhishtaye likewise is the supreme peace-maker. With the mantra "Ekachakra," by ghee offered in portions,
one obtains peace from the planets and grace, no doubt. Having offered ghee with the two "Gavo bhagah" one obtains cows.
Pravadamshah sopat is ordained in the house sacrifice; "Devebhyo vanaspate" is ordained in the tree sacrifice.
The Gayatri is to be known as Vaishnavi; "Tad vishnoh paramam padam" is the destroyer of all sin and the fulfiller of all desires.
Bathing with ghee is said to be supreme for increasing life; with cow-dung there is prosperity; with cow-urine the crushing of sin;
with milk strength and intelligence; with curds growth of prosperity; with kusha water the end of sin; with pancha-gavya a sharer of all;
with shatamula attainment of all; with water from a cow's horn the conqueror of sin; a bath of palasha, bilva, lotus and kusha gives all.
Vacha, the two turmerics and mustaka — a bath is supremely demon-destroying; life-giving, fame-giving, increasing dharma and intelligence;
with golden water, auspiciousness; likewise with silver and copper waters; with jewel waters victory; with all scents good fortune;
with fruit waters likewise health; with amalaka waters supreme prosperity; with sesame and mustard, prosperity; with priyangu, good fortune;
with lotus, water lily and kadamba, prosperity; with bala and tree waters strength. A bath with water from Vishnu's feet is best of all baths.
Ekaki, ekakamaya — one should perform the single Arka by rule; with the hymn "Akrandayati" one should bind a jewel on the hand;
kushtha, patha, vacha, shunthi, conch, iron and the like jewel. Lord of all desires is the Lord Hari;
by worship of him alone one obtains all desires. Having bathed him with ghee and milk and worshipped, he is a destroyer of bile disorder;
having given an offering of five mudgas one is freed from dysentery; having bathed with pancha-gavya one destroys wind disease;
by bathing with the two oils and by great worship, a destroyer of phlegm disease; ghee, oil and honey: bath of three juices is supreme.
A bath with ghee and water; with two oils; with sesame and ghee oil; honey, sugarcane juice and milk: the bath is remembered as three-sweet;
ghee, sugarcane juice, oil and honey are the three juices for prosperity; an anointing is three-white, with camphor, ushira and sandal;
sandal, agaru, camphor, musk with saffron — Vishnu's fivefold anointing gives the fruit of all desires;
the three fragrances, camphor, likewise sandal and saffron; musk with camphor, malaya (sandal) gives all desires.
